style: refined painterly illustration inspired by ancient Indian and Gandharan Buddhist murals and Ajanta cave paintings, soft gouache texture, subtle gold-leaf highlights, muted earthy palette of ochre, saffron, terracotta, deep indigo and jade, gentle warm volumetric light, serene contemplative mood, cinematic but not photorealistic.

characters.AVALOKITESHVARA: graceful serene bodhisattva in Indian princely attire, tall jeweled crown bearing a tiny seated Amitabha Buddha, long dark hair in a high topknot, white and pale gold flowing silk scarves, jeweled necklaces, holding a pink lotus, soft halo
characters.SHARIPUTRA: lean elderly Indian Buddhist monk around 60, shaved head, short grey stubble, sharp wise eyes, light saffron-yellow robe over the left shoulder, barefoot
characters.KING MILINDA: Indo-Greek king Menander I (2nd century BCE), clean-shaven, short curly brown hair, white Greek royal diadem ribbon, white chiton with a deep purple cloak fastened by a gold brooch, leather sandals
characters.NAGASENA: Indian Buddhist monk around 40, shaved head, round calm face, gentle smile, dark reddish-brown robe over the left shoulder, black alms bowl
